description: Gold/silver ground-truth scenarios for phrase similarity metrics on stems. Each entry asserts that a specific metric in a time window of a specific stem should be above/below a threshold. Used to catch regressions when tuning phrase_spec_sim and related metrics.
note: Scenarios are 10-second windows viewed at lag=16 (16-beat blocks) unless otherwise specified, matching how the dashboard default looks. Confidence: gold = manually verified by listening + logic; silver = inferred from signal analysis.

scenarios.song: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know_
scenarios.rationale: Silent gap ~2:08-2:14. The current 16-beat block is silence (reverb tail). The previous 16-beat block is also the decaying tail of the chorus — no new note attacks in either block. Both sides have equivalent 'nothing playing' content, so similarity should be ~1.0. The old audibility-weighted metric (Spec Old) shows ~0.357 here because the previous block reaches back into the loud chorus, inflating its weight; the onset-weighted metric (Spec New) correctly returns 1.0 because neither block has fresh attacks.

scenarios.song: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know_
scenarios.rationale: Verse 2 settling in after ~2:14. Window starts at 136s to skip the 1-2s transition ramp as the block boundaries shift. By 136s the current block is fully in the new riff and the previous block is fully in silence → 'notes vs silence' → similarity ~0.57. Complement to the silence scenario: the metric must distinguish 'both silent' from 'one has notes'.

scenarios.song: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know_
scenarios.rationale: Mid-verse riff ~0:50-1:05. The same guitar riff repeats consistently here, so the current 16-beat block and the previous one should have nearly identical spectral content → similarity near 1.0.

scenarios.song: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know_
scenarios.rationale: Chorus ~1:35-1:55. The chorus has richer harmonic content that varies beat-to-beat compared to the verse riff. The metric should show genuine variation (not pinned to 1.0). A dynamic range below 0.18 would suggest the metric is being over-smoothed or pinned to a single value in active sections.
